title: Halcyon Drift Rising Revisited
author: Dominic Dunmore
blurb: Elodie Winterbourne, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
